messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — Cascade Legal's security questionnaire (SIG + bespoke appendix) landed and is due next Friday. They requested: data retention policy for logs & embeddings, an HSM/KMS attestation sample, and reproducible steps for an intermittent 401 their devs saw calling embeddings. Can eng/security help assemble evidence and a short repro?

alex_eng: I can take logs and a repro. Quick Q: where do we drop the exported evidence (pdfs/log samples) for CS to attach? Confluence page or a signed S3 export? @tina_security any redaction rules?

maria_cs: Confluence is fine for the questionnaire summary, but for official attestation customers want signed artifacts in a secure export (S3 link with limited access or via support bundle). If it's an internal attestation we can redact serials. Need the final bundle by Thu EOD to have time for review.

alex_eng: OK. I'll gather logs from their reported window (2025-03-12 09:10-09:23 UTC) and try to reproduce the 401. Will create an export task.

deploy-bot: Export task created — id 8742 by alex_eng. Destination: restricted-s3://cs-exports/cascade-legal/8742/ (expires in 7 days).

sam_support: FYI their dev shared a short snippet that triggered the 401: they were calling /v1/embeddings with an API key issued 2024-09 that had been rotated for their account. Also saw missing X-Org header in the request. Short repro I used: 

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-oldkey123"
     -H "Content-Type: application/json"
     -d '{"input":"test","model":"text-embedding-ada-002"}'
     https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```

Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key"}

sam_support: If the org header is omitted and the key has been rotated there are cases where the request returns 401 rather than 403. We should capture the auth chain in logs.

alex_eng: Reproduced locally when I used an expired key + no X-Org header. Added a minimal repro that hits our staging endpoint at 250 req/min for 2 minutes to mimic burst. Logs attached to export task 8742: staging-auth.log (filtered) and embedding-reqs.jsonl (request traces).

alex_eng: Example filtered log line: 
```
2025-03-12T09:12:07.342Z [auth] user=cascade-dev svc=embed path=/v1/embeddings status=401 api_key_id=ak-xxxx reason=key_rotated missing_header=X-Org
```

alex_eng: For the SIG form we should provide: the log sample (redacted), a short steps-to-reproduce, and our mitigation notes (we now surface clearer error codes and recommend checks when keys rotate).

tina_security: We have a standard HSM/KMS attestation package and a one-page redaction-friendly extract. Location (internal): vault:/attestations/kms/2025-rotation-summary.pdf. I can generate a customer-facing extract with serial numbers and account IDs redacted. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 UTC.

tina_security: Retention policy summary for SIG: hosted default — logs and embeddings request traces retained 30 days; audit-only logs (admin console, key rotation events) retained 1 year; enterprise/customers can request extended retention and provide justification under contract. We'll include the policy doc link in the export. (Policy doc: https://confluence.redwood/inference/security/retention-policy)

maria_cs: Great. Can we also include a short statement about key rotation and how auth failures surface to clients (recommended client checks: check for broken sessions, update stored API keys, ensure X-Org/Org header present)? I'll paste into the questionnaire.

alex_eng: Draft for SIG: "When API keys are rotated, requests using the old key will return 401. If organization headers are omitted, requests may also surface as 401 depending on routing; clients should validate and refresh keys and include org headers. We provide guidance in SDKs to surface clearer errors on key revocation." Feel free to edit.

maria_cs: That wording is perfect. I'll include it. Also need a short timeline: deliverables = (1) redacted KMS attestation extract, (2) log sample + repro steps, (3) retention policy excerpt. Target: Thu EOD for upload to export task 8742.

tina_security: Confirming — I'll upload the attestation extract to the export path and DM audit-bot for signing.

audit-bot: Signing request submitted for export 8742. Approver: tina_security. ETA signing token: 2 hours.

amazon-s3-bot: File upload complete: restricted-s3://cs-exports/cascade-legal/8742/kms-extract-redacted.pdf (expires 7d).

maria_cs: Awesome — thanks everyone. Once I have the three items I'll populate the SIG/appendix and ask Cascade for a short ack. If anything blocks the export deadline ping me here. :thumbsup:

alex_eng: I'll follow up after I finish sanitizing the logs. Expect a short readme in the export explaining filenames and redactions.

sam_support: Added an internal note in Zendesk ticket #CSD-3427 linking to export 8742 and the reproduction steps.

maria_cs: Closing loop — will set a calendar reminder for Thu 16:00 UTC to confirm submission. Thanks all.
